objects.name: Detection technique coverage: tomcat-session-file-upload-attempt
objects.description: This detection identifies potential exploitation of CVE-2025-24813 in Apache Tomcat through the initial stage of the attack. This first phase occurs when an attacker attempts to upload a malicious serialized Java object with a .session file extension via an HTTP PUT request.
